about: Offline agent perps summary contracts from exact source (BE-3775). Every time is on forty-one made-up days, and every figure, coin and hash is made up. api-source rows are answers built by Candle's pure source (the perps profile bundle and hourly components, the board figures, the publish over a prior build with two daily points, perpsSummaryOf) from one made-up wallet's stored facts, in a stand-in route envelope (publishedBuildId, seq); each window's row also carries the series its max drawdown reads. The wallet's address is hashed inside that source and is in no row. api-stub rows are response stand-ins: no perps history, a slug answer, and refusals carrying the route's own code and words. mcp, sdk and cli rows read the same answers through the registered local tool, the SDK and `candle agent <id> --perps` over an intercepted fetch; a served answer is kept once, in its api row, and each of those rows names it (`relays`) with the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of what that surface gave, which the recorder checked is the same answer. chart-split rows run the chart's split as the pure function it is over a stand-in spot chart. docs rows are the public page's own lines (its three copies agree), read as text. The database, the public gate, the perps jobs, the venue and the keyed API route are not executed, and no deployed behavior is claimed.

outcome.title: Get an agent's perps summary
outcome.description: One published agent's Hyperliquid perps summary for a window (all, 24h, 7d or 30d; default all) (GET /api/v1/agent/records/{profileId}/perps). No key needed. Reads only. summary: netUsd (realized + funding - fees + unrealized change), realizedUsd, unrealizedUsd, fundingUsd (positive when received), feesUsd (Hyperliquid fees, Candle's builder fee included), volumeUsd (sum of px x sz of the agent's fills, builder-dex fills included; builderDexVolumeUsd is their part), feesToVolumePct (fees over main-exchange volume), roundsClosed, wins, losses, winRatePct, largestWinUsd, largestLossUsd, highestLeverage and averageLeverage (rounds with leverage not recorded are left out and counted in leverageNotRecordedRounds), liquidations and maxDrawdownUsd (peak to trough of the cumulative perps P&L, dollars). hyperliquidSpot, when present, is the agent's Hyperliquid spot part of the same window, beside the perps figures and never inside netUsd (it belongs to the record's Spot bucket). null means not known, never zero. summary is null for an agent with no perps history; available false means the perps are delayed (asOfMs). asOfMs is when the figures were true. The same figures as the agent page. An agent that is not published answers RECORD_NOT_FOUND. No wallet address or balance. A measured record, not a forecast.

lines: ### Public agent perps summary (`GET /api/v1/agent/records/{profileId}/perps`, BE-3775)

Public and keyless. One published agent's Hyperliquid perps summary for a window, `window=all` (default), `24h`, `7d` or `30d`; anything else is 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` with `error.field` `window`. The figures come from the same published board build as the record, chart and positions (`publishedBuildId`, `perpsSnapshotId`), behind the same public gate: a private, unpublished, hidden or turned-off agent and a malformed id all get the same 404 `RECORD_NOT_FOUND`. Returns `{ success: true, window, publishedBuildId, summary, seq }`. `summary` is `null` for a public agent with no perps history (no summary row on its page); `{ available: false, asOfMs, partial: true }` while its perps are delayed (no figures, never zero). Otherwise:
| Field | Formula |
| `netUsd` | `realizedUsd + fundingUsd - feesUsd + unrealizedUsd`, the record's `perpsNetUsd` for the window |
| `realizedUsd` | closed P&L of the agent's fills in the window (fills after the window's start observation, through its end observation) |
| `unrealizedUsd` | unrealized P&L at the end observation, less (for 24h, 7d and 30d) the unrealized at the window's start |
| `fundingUsd` | funding payments in the window, positive when received |
| `feesUsd` | Hyperliquid's fees on those fills, Candle's builder fee included; a rebate is negative |

| `volumeUsd` | the sum of `px x sz` (USDC notional) over the agent's fills in the same interval, on every perp dex: builder-dex (`dex:COIN`) fills included, `builderDexVolumeUsd` is their part. A fill with no stored price is left out and counted in `volumeUnpricedFills` (then `partial` is true) |

| `feesToVolumePct` | `feesUsd / (volumeUsd - builderDexVolumeUsd) x 100`: builder-dex fees are charged in each dex's own token and are not in the record's fees yet, so the ratio is main exchange over main exchange |

| `roundsClosed`, `wins`, `losses` | rounds (open to flat) closed in the window that count: complete, and the agent's at the close. A round's P&L is closed P&L - fees + funding while it was open; above zero is a win, below a loss |
| `winRatePct` | `wins / (wins + losses) x 100`; a break-even round is neither; null with no decided round |
| `largestWinUsd`, `largestLossUsd` | the best round above zero and the worst round below zero; null when there is none |

| `highestLeverage`, `averageLeverage` | over the rounds closed in the window: each round's leverage is the last Candle leverage order on that coin before it opened, else the highest leverage an hourly snapshot saw during it. A round with neither is "leverage not recorded", left out of both figures and counted in `leverageNotRecordedRounds` |
| `liquidations` | rounds closed in the window by a liquidation of the agent's own wallet |

| `maxDrawdownUsd` | peak to trough, in dollars, of the agent's cumulative perps P&L series (realized net plus unrealized): hourly points inside 30 days; `all` adds the daily points before them and starts at the first daily point (the chart's "perps counted from" date). Positive; 0 when it never fell; no capital base |

`asOfMs` is when the figures were true (the oldest wallet's observation, as the record's `perpsAsOfMs`; with `perpsProvisional: true`, the provisional read and `perpsCertifiedAsOfMs` the hourly certified cutoff under it). `coverageFromMs` is when Candle began recording the agent's wallet: all-time figures count from there. A bundle published before these figures existed answers them `null` (unknown, never zero) until the next board build. No wallet address or account value. A deployment that does not serve the agent board from Postgres yet answers 503 `perps_summary_unavailable` (`retryable: false`) for every profile.

`hyperliquidSpot` (BE-4221) is the agent's Hyperliquid spot part of the same window, beside the perps figures and never inside `netUsd`; it is absent for an agent with no Hyperliquid spot fill and no spot observation holding a token; an agent whose observations show a spot holding but who has no fills gets a block with zero realized figures (and its holdings' `unpriced`, if any). The record carries the same block (on the record and in its `totals`) and adds it to the Spot bucket: `totals.realizedNetUsd` gains `realizedUsd` (net of sell fees; a base-token fee on a buy is in the cost basis, average cost), `unrealizedUsd` and `totalPnlUsd` gain the tracked holdings' value at the bundle's certified cutoff less their remaining cost (a rolling window: the change since its start observation). `feesUsd` and `volumeUsd` are informational (volume is the USDC notional of the window's spot fills). `unpriced` counts fills and holdings with no price; `untrackedSoldCoins` counts the base coins (not a quantity) with a sell beyond the tracked quantity, all time through the cutoff (those tokens arrived from outside the record: no cost, no realized P&L). `partial` is true, with `partialReasons`, when the perps window is partial, or a gap, an unpriced fill or holding, an unreadable observation (also for a wallet the agent no longer owns at the end observation but traded spot on) or a missing spot pair list means the figure is a floor; it is never shown as zero. Fees paid in a base token are stored to 1e-6, so base-fee dust below that rounds away. Seasons and the chart do not carry the Hyperliquid spot part yet. Clients: SDK `AgentHyperliquidSpotFigures` on `AgentPublicRecord.hyperliquidSpot`, `AgentRecordTotals.hyperliquidSpot` and the perps summary (0.6.36); CLI `candle agent record` prints a `Spot P&L includes Hyperliquid spot` line with these figures and counts when the block is present (0.13.45); the MCP record and perps summary tools describe it (0.10.44).

The chart read (`/records/{profileId}/chart`) also splits every point while the agent's perps are available: `spotPnlUsd` (the point before perps were added) and `perpsPnlUsd` (what perps added; 0 on a day before perps were published), so `spotPnlUsd + perpsPnlUsd = totalPnlUsd` at every point. The combined `totalPnlUsd` line is unchanged; a spot-only agent's chart carries neither field.

Clients: SDK `getAgentPerpsSummary(profileId, { window })`; CLI `candle agent <profile-id|slug> --perps [--window all|24h|7d|30d] [--json]`; MCP `candle_get_agent_perps_summary` (keyless, local server).
